title: Synergy Baseball App: Getting Started
description: Install the Synergy Baseball app, log in, and find your way around the toolbar, settings menu and filters panel.

modules.title: What the Baseball App Does
modules.summary: The app pairs rich data filtering with video playback for any team, season, game or player.
learning_objectives: Describe what the Synergy Baseball app is for
List the main things you can do after selecting a player or team
modules.content:
## One place for data and film

The Synergy Baseball app delivers rich data filtering and video playback so you can generate data, with the associated video, for one or more **teams, seasons, games or players**.

## What you can do once you select a player or team

- Visualize data in detailed **pitch charts and spray charts**, and print them to PDF with additional filters.
- Review **basic statistics**.
- Watch the associated **game film**, including side-by-side video for multi-angle events.
- Build **multiple advanced reports** to analyze and share.
- **Save reports** to reuse later.
- Look at **pitch-by-pitch detail** for specific games in Single Game view.

## Why it matters

Instead of pulling stats in one place and hunting for film in another, every number in the app is tied to the clips behind it. That is what makes it useful for scouting, player development and game prep.

![The Pitcher filter panel in the Baseball app](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565361-01.jpg)

questions.question: Which best describes the Synergy Baseball app?

questions.explanation: The app combines rich data filtering with associated video playback.

questions.explanation: Charts can be printed as a PDF with additional filters.

questions.question: Which view gives pitch-by-pitch details for specific games?

modules.title: Installing and Logging In
modules.summary: Install on PC or Mac, then log in through your browser and tick Remember Me.
learning_objectives: Install the app on PC or Mac
Complete first-time login and enable Remember Me
modules.content:
## Installing

Download the app from the Synergy Baseball client download page, then follow the steps for your computer.

### PC

1. After clicking the download link, the installation screen opens automatically.

![PC installation screen](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565362-01.jpeg)
2. Click **Install**. If prompted, click **Run**.
3. When installation finishes, the app opens and asks you to log in. Select **Remember me** to save your credentials.

![Login screen with the Remember me box](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565362-02.jpg)

### Mac

1. After clicking the download link, the download screen opens.

![Mac download screen](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565362-03.jpg)
2. Click **Download**.
3. Open the DMG file and **drag the Synergy Baseball App icon into the Applications folder**. This is what lets you receive notifications about future updates.
4. Open the app from Applications. If asked to confirm, click **Open**.

## Logging in for the first time

The login page stores credentials more securely than before.

1. Make sure your preferred **language** is selected.
2. Tick **Remember Me** to store credentials for future use.
3. Click **Click here to log in**. This launches your web browser.
4. Enter your username and password in the browser and click **Login**. You are returned to the app automatically.

If Remember Me is selected, the app logs you in automatically next time.

questions.question: On a Mac, why should you drag the app into the Applications folder?
options: So you receive notifications about future updates
It is required to log in
questions.explanation: Placing it in Applications ensures update notifications.

questions.question: Where do you enter your username and password on first login?
options: In a web browser launched by the app
questions.explanation: The Click here to log in button opens a browser for credentials, then returns you to the app.

questions.question: What does ticking Remember Me do?
options: Stores credentials so the app logs you in automatically next time
questions.explanation: Remember Me stores credentials for automatic login in future sessions.

modules.title: Toolbar, Settings and Filters Panel
modules.summary: The top toolbar, settings menu and left-hand filters panel are your navigation for every view.
learning_objectives: Name the items on the top toolbar
Find video quality and unit settings
Explain how the Filters menu behaves
modules.content:
## Top toolbar (in every view)

From left to right:

1. **Video playback**: choose the in-app **Player**, the **Synergy Editor**, or **Compare** (split screen).
2. **Add Report**: appears only after you have created an initial report.
3. **Multigame View**
4. **Reports View**
5. **Single Game View**
6. **Saved Reports**
7. **Settings menu**: the three-line hamburger icon.

![The top toolbar](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565364-01.jpg)

![The settings menu](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565364-02.jpg)

## Settings menu

- **Settings > General**: set the video cache folder, access application log files, and choose pitch velocity units.

![General settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565364-03.jpg)
- **Settings > Video**: set video quality to **Low, Medium or High**.

![Video quality settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565364-04.jpg)
- **About**: version details.

![About dialog](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565364-05.jpg)
- **Help**: contact Synergy support.
- **Video Guides**: the How-To Video Library.
- **Upload Schedule**: opens the Baseball Portal to see your team's upload schedule.
- **Admin**: Baseball Portal account management. **Only team admins see this.**
- **Logout** and **Exit**.

## Filters menu

The Filters menu runs down the **left side** of the screen and shows in every view **except Saved Reports**. The filters available can change depending on the active view, your earlier inputs and your selections in other filters.

![The Filters menu on the left side of the screen](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565364-06.jpg)

questions.question: Where do you change video quality to Low, Medium or High?
questions.explanation: Video quality lives under Settings > Video.

questions.question: Who can see the Admin option in the settings menu?
questions.explanation: Admin is visible only to team admins.

questions.question: In which view is the Filters menu NOT shown?
questions.explanation: The Filters menu appears in every view except Saved Reports.

questions.question: When does the Add Report button appear on the toolbar?
options: Only after you create an initial report
questions.explanation: Add Report shows once you have created an initial report.
